sql: SELECT count(*) AS listing_count FROM (SELECT f.posting_key FROM fct_posting f JOIN posting_skills ps ON f.posting_key = ps.posting_key WHERE f.is_open = true AND f.remote_us = true AND f.is_canonical_listing = true AND ps.skill IN ('Python', 'SQL') GROUP BY f.posting_key HAVING count(DISTINCT ps.skill) = 2)
